messages:
anya: Hey support — customer on @redwood/sdk-js 3.1.0 (Node 18.16.0) behind a corporate HTTP proxy is seeing intermittent 502/504 from our API and then duplicate POSTs on retry. They say billing shows multiple charge attempts. Repro attached below.
kevin: Can you paste the exact SDK + undici + node versions and a minimal repro snippet?
anya: sure — undici 5.8.0. Repro (simplified):
```js
const { RedwoodClient } = require('@redwood/sdk-js');
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const ac = new AbortController();
setTimeout(() => ac.abort(), 2000); // simulate short timeout behind proxy
await client.post('/v1/generate', { body: JSON.stringify({ prompt: 'hi' }), signal: ac.signal });
```
Behavior: client gets a 504 from upstream, SDK retries, and customer sees duplicate billed attempts.
sam: That pattern screams at undici abort/stream interaction we saw before — old undici + proxy tunneling can end up with the request body not being drained/rewound so retry sends another POST. Which can lead to double charges for non-idempotent endpoints.
kevin: Right. undici 5.8 had a known backoff/abort timing edge with CONNECT proxy tunnels. Workarounds besides upgrading: 1) send bodies as a simple string with Content-Length (not a streaming body), 2) set agent keepAlive:false for the proxy so sockets aren't reused in the same bad state, or 3) reduce SDK retries to 0/1.
kevin: Example workaround snippet:
```js
const { Agent } = require('undici');
const agent = new Agent({ connect: { rejectUnauthorized: false }, keepAlive: false });
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, agent, retryOptions: { maxRetries: 1 } });
```
anya: Customer hesitant to upgrade undici/SDK right now. Can we confirm if SDK respects user-provided agent in all request paths?
kevin: Yes our client passes through the provided undici Agent, but some convenience helpers used for streaming responses historically created their own agent; that was fixed in 3.2.0. For 3.1.0 there are paths that still construct an internal agent for streaming.
sam: If they can't upgrade, ask them to 1) convert to non-streaming request bodies, 2) set maxRetries:1 and 3) set keepAlive:false on their proxy agent. That avoids the retry sending a second POST on the same socket error.
anya: Logged the customer's logs and traces and escalated: ENG-4218. support-bot: escalated to eng-infra (ticket #34267).
support-bot: ETA assigned, eng-oncall picking up.
eng-oncall: I'll reproduce with a local proxy (squid) and Node18+undici5.8 to confirm. If we repro, we'll either patch SDK to avoid internal agents in 3.1.x or provide an emergency patch to guard retries for non-idempotent routes. ETA ~4h.
anya: Thanks — I'll relay the workaround to the customer (keepAlive:false + maxRetries:1 + non-stream body) and update ticket notes. :thumbsup:
